title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR — when corrupted in Adam? same reductio as before
pass_a_gloss: Then the Pelagian rises with the same timing trap: when were we corrupted in Adam by his sin—only when he sinned and corrupted himself? Whoever was so corrupted as to be guilty of eternal death then was truly and properly corrupted, and so then truly was. Therefore today's newborn already was when Adam fell. Those who set snares for others put themselves into them, and fall into the pit they dug.
pass_b_english: The Pelagian will now rise, and relying on this argumentation will ask, When were we corrupted in Adam by his sin? When he himself sinned, and by sinning corrupted himself, or at another time? Surely when he himself sinned, and by sinning corrupted himself. Many, nay all, have been warned by the sin for us, but also by the vice of that fall. Hear now. Those who were so corrupted that they were made guilty of eternal death, those were truly and properly corrupted. Those who were truly and properly corrupted, those then when they were corrupted truly and properly were. Therefore has the infant who is now born truly been, when Adam was sinning, and by sinning corrupting himself? So those who had made snares for others put themselves into them, and into the pit which they had prepared for others they themselves fall.
source_text: Insurget iam Pelagianus, & hac argumentatione fretus quaeret, Quando corrupti sumus in Adamo peccato eius? An cum ipse peccavit, & peccando se corrupit, an alio tempore? Certe cum ipse peccavit, & peccando se corrupit. Multi, imo omnes peccato pro nobis, sed & vitio illius lapsi moniti sunt. Audi iam. Qui ita corrupti fuerunt, ut mortis aeternae rei facti sint, illi vere & proprie corrupti fuerunt. Qui vere & proprie corrupti fuerunt, illi tunc cum corrupti sunt, vere & proprie fuerunt. Ergone infans qui nunc nascitur, vere fuit, cum Adamus peccaret, & peccando seipsum corrumperet? Ita qui laqueos aliis confecerant, in eos se induunt, & quam foveam aliis paraverant in eam ipsimet incidunt.

choices.choice: When corrupted? → infant already was when Adam fell
